title: Graphics Not So High Tech
text: I am a huge Star Wars fan so I was excited to see this offer from Amazon.  However, when I received my first t-shirt last week I was a bit disappointed.  It is definitely a Star Wars themed shirt with Ewoks from Return of the Jedi, but it looks very "kiddish".  I will keep it, but do hope that future t-shirts look better. Or I hope that the design looks more like an adult and is professional looking.  In a way the shirt I received looks a bit cheap, the design that is, not the quality of the t-shirt itself.
label: neutral
